$comment: Board house limits for a 2-layer, 1 oz board, in mm, read from each house's own capabilities page on the date given. Fields listed under `ours` are BetterCad's working values, chosen above the house's minimum; the rest are the house's limits. Check the page again before changing a number, and update `checked`.

presets.name: JLCPCB, 2 layers
notes: Track and gap: 0.10 mm each at the least on 1 and 2 layer boards.
Smallest via: 0.15 mm hole in a 0.25 mm pad; the pad should be 0.15 mm wider than the hole.
Ring round a plated hole: 0.20 mm or more, 0.25 mm recommended.
Holes: 0.45 mm apart for pads, 0.2 mm for vias. The check uses the larger.
Solder mask opens 1:1 with the pad.

presets.name: PCBWay, standard
notes: Track and gap: 0.1 mm each at the least.
Holes from 0.15 mm, but anything under 0.2 mm costs extra, so the check asks for 0.2 mm.
Ring round a hole: 0.15 mm or more.
Hole spacing (16 mil) and edge distance (0.25 mm) are from the page's advanced table; the standard table gives none.
